en.t: After the chanting was finished, we ate rice porridge.

units.source_text: 饭后做诸如除草、打扫庭院、劈柴一类杂务。

en.t: After the meal, we did odd jobs such as weeding, sweeping the courtyard, and chopping firewood.

units.source_text: 学校开学的话，做完杂务就该是上学的时间了。

en.t: When school was in session, once the chores were finished it was time to go to school.

units.source_text: 从学校回来，不久就进晚餐。

en.t: After returning from school, before long we went in to dinner.

units.source_text: 餐罢，有时听住持讲授经典教义。

en.t: After the meal, we sometimes listened to the abbot lecture on the scriptures and doctrine.
At nine o'clock came "opening the pillow," that is, going to bed.
